title: Average Speed and Journey Calculations
introduction: Consolidate primary mathematics and prepare for secondary study through average speed and journey calculations.
definition: Average speed equals total distance divided by total elapsed time. It is not generally the arithmetic mean of separate speeds. Include stops when the question asks for the average over the entire journey. Convert time and distance units consistently.

visuals.label: Distance-time graph
visuals.description: Constant speed gives a straight rising line.
visuals.alt: Distance-time graph — Constant speed gives a straight rising line.

examples.question: Travel 90 km in 1.5 h, stop 30 min, then travel 60 km in 1 h.
steps: Total distance 150 km; elapsed time 3 h.
